title: Signed tensor model for a cone of a unit endomorphism
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with a monoidal structure [def-sfb-monoidal-category] whose tensor is additive in each variable and with countable coproducts. Use unbounded integer cochain complexes, localization $Q$, and the cone convention of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and the direct-sum total tensor of [def-sfb-preserves-kflat-quasi-iso]. Fix any endomorphism $a:\mathbf1\to\mathbf1$ and put $P_a=\operatorname{Cone}(a[0]:\mathbf1[0]\to\mathbf1[0])$. For an object $M$ put
$$a^R_M=\rho_M\circ(1_M\otimes a)\circ\rho_M^{-1},\qquad a^L_M=\lambda_M\circ(a\otimes1_M)\circ\lambda_M^{-1}.$$
They act termwise on a complex $C$. There are isomorphisms in $D(\mathcal A)$
$$Q\operatorname{Tot}(C\otimes P_a)\cong Q\operatorname{Cone}(a^R_C),\qquad Q\operatorname{Tot}(P_a\otimes C)\cong Q\operatorname{Cone}(a^L_C),$$
natural in chain maps $f:C\to C'$, with the following specified chain-isomorphism representatives $\phi^R_C,\phi^L_C$. In degree $n$, identify both tensor totals with $C^n\oplus C^{n+1}$ by the unitors, ordering the summand from $P_a^0$ first and that from $P_a^{-1}$ second. Their differentials, expressed as biproduct matrices, are
$$d_R^n=\begin{pmatrix}d_C^n&(-1)^{n+1}a^R_{C^{n+1}}\\0&d_C^{n+1}\end{pmatrix},\qquad d_L^n=\begin{pmatrix}d_C^n&a^L_{C^{n+1}}\\0&-d_C^{n+1}\end{pmatrix}.$$
The representatives are $\phi_C^{R,n}=\operatorname{diag}(1,(-1)^{n+1})$ and $\phi_C^{L,n}=\operatorname{diag}(1,1)$, each its own inverse in these coordinates. On a map $f$ each total map and each cone map is $\operatorname{diag}(f^n,f^{n+1})$ in the corresponding coordinates, so
$$\phi^R_{C'}\circ\operatorname{Tot}(f\otimes1_{P_a})=\operatorname{Cone}(f,f)\circ\phi^R_C,\qquad
\phi^L_{C'}\circ\operatorname{Tot}(1_{P_a}\otimes f)=\operatorname{Cone}(f,f)\circ\phi^L_C.$$
Both representatives preserve the inclusion of the unshifted copy of $C$.
